verdict.rationale: incident.io offers public and private Status Pages for incident communication, and Workflows can auto-publish to a status page whenever an incident is updated. That gives stakeholders structured updates outside the incident channel, and AI Suggestions help responders draft those updates. However, nothing in the evidence shows stakeholders can subscribe to updates, and private pages are only mentioned in passing rather than documented as an internal-stakeholder channel. Missing for 10: documented subscription mechanism for internal stakeholders (email/Slack subscriptions to incidents or private status pages), explicit internal-stakeholder update feature docs, independent corroboration.
